Overview

Orléans is a city in Centre-Val de Loire with a population of 116,000. The city of Joan of Arc on the Loire River, with a rich medieval history and a strategic location south of Paris. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
